LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Schadenfreude
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Schadenfreude (O-05-76) is an iron keyhole box that thrives on your gaze.\nNever watch it on-screen while working; if it breaches, pan the camera away to freeze it motionless inside its armored shell.
